summary: Backend: 85/85 pytest cases pass (35 new + 50 carried-over). All new endpoints verified: /api/wellness/profile GET/PUT (with bad-goal/bad-activity/bad-date 400s and blank-default GET), /api/wellness/log POST/GET/DELETE (desc-sorted by date, cross-user delete returns 404, list isolation), /api/wellness/suggest (400 without goal, returns calorie_target+macro_focus+meal_focus[]+workout_focus[]+weekly_split+encouragement when goal set; AI call ~3s via emergentintegrations), /api/prayers/examen (5 Ignatian prompts gratitude/petition/review/forgiveness/renewal), /api/prayers/examination (9 sections), /api/journal POST kind ∈ {free, examen, examination} with structured payload (unknown kind normalised to 'free'), /api/journal/{id}/confess sets confessed_at and returns 404 for missing/foreign entries, /api/churches/nearby ~Vatican returns Overpass results with distance_km + is_starred scoped to user, bad lat/lng -> 400, /api/churches/save/saved/{id} idempotent upsert + cross-user isolation + 404 on double-delete. Regression smoke: liturgical, preferences, journal list, root health all still pass. Found and FIXED one CRITICAL bug in POST /api/wellness/log (server.py:902-917): `created_at` was present in both `$set` (via doc dict) and `$setOnInsert`, causing MongoDB WriteError code 40 ('Updating the path created_at would create a conflict at created_at') → endpoint returned 500. Fix: moved `created_at` out of $set, keeping it only in $setOnInsert so original timestamp is preserved across same-day re-weighs. Frontend: code review confirms tab bar has the 5 expected tabs (Today/Meals/Workouts/Wellness/Profile) with calendar hidden via href:null and correct testIDs (tab-today/meals/workouts/wellness/profile). Login screen renders and rejects unauth requests. Interactive UI flows beyond the login gate could not be exercised because Emergent Google OAuth + AsyncStorage v2 web (IndexedDB-backed, not localStorage) prevents external session seeding from a headless browser; main agent should self-test those screens (Wellness goal editor, Churches permission/star, Journal mode chips, Calendar entry dots) in dev.

rca_of_issue: RCA — POST /api/wellness/log returned 500. Mongo upsert update document had `created_at: now` inside the `$set` doc dict AND `$setOnInsert: {created_at: now}` in the same update operator block. MongoDB requires that a field cannot appear in more than one update operator, raising WriteError(code=40, 'Updating the path created_at would create a conflict at created_at'). Reproduction: POST /api/wellness/log {date:'2026-01-10', weight_kg:80.5} -> 500 with traceback `pymongo.errors.WriteError` in backend.err.log. Fix applied at server.py:902-917: moved `created_at` out of the $set doc and kept it solely in $setOnInsert so the original creation timestamp is preserved across same-day re-weighs while later fields (weight_kg, note, log_id) get refreshed. Verified by all 7 TestWeightLog tests now passing post-fix.
